answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a vine checkpoint. The echo chain is verified at intake and ridge publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Repeating the trick 45 times costs 8 separate deposits and 36 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
